blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Senate panel on agriculture, food and agrarian reform chairperson Sen. Kiko Pangilinan has sought an inquiry into low farmgate prices of hogs and chicken amid increasing production and feed costs. On Thursday, Pangilinan filed Senate Resolution No. 726 directing his committee to investigate ways to protect local producers’ profits and secure a sustainable food supply. “Continuously depressed farmgate prices alongside high production costs may force hog and poultry raisers, especially small and backyard raisers, to reduce production or exit the industry altogether, thereby deepening the country’s dependence on imports and undermining long-term food security,” Pangilinan said in the […]...
